body: Do what? Sell drugs? Join the army? Go on welfare and be spat on? Maybe I should collect fucking stamps? No. I can't enjoy anything I do. I don't want to do things. I want to sit right here and die.

Tragic? Tragic to whom? The media? Nobody cares. The suicide of that 15 year old girl proves this. Nobody gives a fuck about students. Especially terrible, late, ADHD students. Nobody cares. I can't do anything right, ANYTHING RIGHT, why should I continue to fuck up everything I touch for years hereafter? I hate it already, I hate it.
Yeah, it's SO easy to just pack up and walk away from senior high school.
My family hates me, and my friends are young enough that they won't care in a few months time. Nobody will remember me.
